If you want to learn how bitcoin really works then you have to read "Mastering Bitcoin" by O'Reilly. This will tell you all you need to know.

Amazon product link: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/1449374042

It's also available for free here: https://github.com/aantonop/bitcoinbook
You'll want at least some basic software development experience to fully appreciate the books value. Hell, most of it won't make any sense if you don't understand some computer science basics.

I just finished Digital Gold my Nathaniel Popper. It doesn't do a deep-dive into the inner workings of bitcoin but gives you a good perspective on how things got started. To truly understand Bitcoin, go with Mastering Bitcoin by Andreas M. Antonopoulous (link is to free book, but I bought the hardcopy), it is really good. I am also going to try this Coursera course in September.
